The institute accepts entrance exams such as JEE Main, NATA, CUET-UG, etc. for admission to specific courses. For admission under Management Quota, aspirants need to qualify a written test followed by a personal interview for BTech. For MBA, aspirants will get admission under Management Quota based on merit in the last qualifying exam.

faqs.question: Can I join MIT Moradabad directly?
faqs.answer: Candidates wishing to get direct admission against the vacant seats from UPTAC Counselling are required to get registered in admission cell of MIT Moradabad. The registrations of eligible candidates are done with a payment of INR 11,000. The institute offer admission to candidates against the remaining vacant seats after UPTAC Counselling based on merit in the last qualifying exam.

faqs.question: How many marks are required to get admission in MIT Moradabad?
faqs.answer: MIT Moradabad eligibility criteria specifies the minimum educational qualification and aggregate required to apply for admission. Below is course-wise eligibility for MIT:CourseCommon EligibilityBTechClass 12 from a recognised board with Physics andMathematicsas compulsory subjects along with Chemistry/Biotechnology/ Biology/ Technical Vocational subject with at least 45% aggregate (40% aggregate for reserved category)BVocClass 12 in any stream from a recognised boardBArchClass 12 from a recognised board or 3-year Diploma in the relevant stream from a recognised universityMBABachelor’s degree of a minimum of 3 years with at least 50% aggregate (45% aggregate for reserved category)

faqs.question: Is CUET accepted at MIT Moradabad?
faqs.answer: Yes, MIT Group of Institutions accepts CUET-UG score for admission to BVoc and BTech programme. Besides, CUET-PG score is accepted for MBA admission. Aspirants after qualifying the respective entrance exam need to participate in the UPTAC Counselling to get a seat in MIT Moradabad.

reviews.review_heading: Overview of MIT Moradabad.
reviews.review_text: Various bare minimum facilities are available, like Wi-Fi, labs, library, etc. Classrooms have AC and well-ventilated windows. Hostel rooms are average and three-sitter. Mess food is average most of the time. The hygiene of the hostel’s mess is quite disappointing.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is quite good in our college. Laboratories have favourable instruments. Library is filled with books. There is a heavy stop of books in the library. The facilities are quite good. Sports facilities are very well. Medical facilities are also provided to us. Canteen and mess are very well maintained in our college.

reviews.review_heading: The placement opportunities are increased.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facilities are available to students in most parts of the campus, including classrooms, libraries, and hotels. The canteen offers snacks, drinks, and light meals. The students are looking for quick bites between classes, and the food here is reasonably priced.

reviews.review_heading: Review of MIT Group of Institutions, Moradabad.
reviews.review_text: In classrooms Wi-Fi and projectors are available. Library is big, one can find any book there.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of faculties, good placements in 2024, and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: In every classroom, there are projectors, and a smart board is available. Wi-Fi and laboratory facilities are awesome. There are GPAT exam books, previous year papers, and semester books by different publishers. I was not admitted to the hostel, but my batchmates are.

reviews.review_heading: A perfect place for software engineers.
reviews.review_text: All buildings are made perfectly. All labs have very good facilities. All neat and clean, with good Wi-Fi and bright lightning. Libraries provide personal space to study. All books are arranged nicely with each topic in them. Hostels are very comfortable.

reviews.review_heading: My college is having a good placement since 2015 and with pretty much decent packages.
reviews.review_text: All classrooms have AC and also many classes with smart boards. Labs are also in a excellent condition. Library is also big and can get every type of book their. Wi-Fi is also nice giving u 2.5-3 mb upload speed and same download. As I am living in local know too much about hostel facilities but know that also nice and good. Food available in canteen is nice and fresh. Their is a proper medical room or cabins in which a specified doctor has been placed by our management with an respectful degree...

reviews.review_heading: Oour college is over-crowded, and I do not recommend joining it.
reviews.review_text: Our college has average infrastructure. There is Wi-Fi but the signal is very low. Classrooms are dirty. Library is average. Canteen is good. Medical facility is not so good. There is no sports teacher, and the ground is very small.

reviews.review_heading: MIT Moradabad is the best college for engineering in Moradabad.
reviews.review_text: Our college offers a Wi-Fi network over the entire campus that works well. There is a vast library. There are labs for the practical subjects. Classrooms are big enough and have air-conditioners. The hostel is better than the rented rooms. The mess food is also good. There is a Mini-Medical and Hospital for students to get treatment. There is a huge ground for football, basketball, volleyball, and badminton.

reviews.review_heading: It is a pretty decent college for admission.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available on campus and in the hostel. The hostel mess is decent. There are play areas and sports grounds. The canteen is also available on campus. Some other shops are also available. The central library has good variety of books.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for CS aspirants.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good with well-equipped machines and tools. The hostel facilities are average. There is a sports community, which organises different sports events. The library is very good and has all the important books. It is silent for self-study.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are very good in our college. The food quality is also better. The hostel facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: It is good for every student .
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of mit is quite average, they have all the stuff for learning purpose of various courses, They have Wi-Fi, good computer labs well maintained as well as good library plus digital library too. Extra curricular activities are well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is decent. Faculty is good and friendly. Placement rate is good in 2022.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is very neat and clean. There are separate buildings for girls and boys. All the hostel rooms have Wi-Fi with high-speed internet. Gym is also available in the hostel. Washrooms are also neat and clean. Mess food is too good. Canteen is also there.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in the Moradabad region.
reviews.review_text: There is good infrastructure in our college campus. There are many facilities like playing grounds and basic facilities like air-conditioned classrooms, a parking system and a good hostel system. There are two separate hostels for girls and boys. I suggest you take admission to this college.

admission_process.title: INMANTEC Institutions Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: INMANTEC Institutions admission is open. Admission to its courses is both merit and entrance-based. The institutions offer various courses at the UG, PG and integrated level. INMANTEC Institutions offer courses such as BCA, BBA, BCom, BA, MBA, MCA etc. The institution is affiliated withCCSU, Meerut. However, the MBA and MCA courses is offered throughAKTU - Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (UPTU). Candidates who are looking for any courses are required to apply either online or offline by visiting the college campus directly or visiting the college's official website. Read the following article to know more aboutINMANTEC Institutionadmission2025:

INMANTEC Institutions admission is open. The college carries out online and offline modes of application for all the courses. The college offers various UG and diploma courses in the fields of engineering, law, pharmacy and others. Admission to all the courses is merit-based excluding MBA and MCA. For admission to MBA and MCA, candidates need to appear in one entrance exam accepted by the college including CUET/JCCAT/XAT/MAT/CAT/RMAT followed by counselling and PI round. Check out INMANTEC Institutions course eligibility & selection criteria in the following table:
CUET/JCCAT/XAT/MAT/CAT/RMAT+ GDPI
*A minimum score of 500 in MAT or equivalent score in any other entrance exam, e.g. JCCAT/XAT/CAT, etc
Download:INMANTEC Institution MBA brochure

Candidates can get the application form for registration along with the prospectus from the institute by mail/courier in person after paying the registration amount of INR 1,000 through the draft or in cash for the specific programme. Candidates can also download the form from the official website.
STEP 1: INMANTEC Institutions Application Process 2025

INMANTEC Institutions application is conducted in both online and offline modes.  The eligible candidates need to apply online on the official website college. It is necessary that the eligible candidates must have completed the entrance exam formalities & must have qualified the eligibility criteria for their respective courses before applying to the college.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds

Admission to the courses is both merit and entrance-based. The selection process includes an entrance exam for admission to MBA and MCA. Further, for other courses, INMANTEC Institutions offer merit-based admission.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation
After candidates get shortlisted, they are required to pay a INMANTEC Institutions fee to confirm their admission.

content.Placements: Overall, about 91% of students get placed, with approximately 92% in core branches like ECE. For AI, the average package is about 5-6 LPA, and top offers reach 13-14 LPA. Prominent recruiters include Airbus, L&T, Siemens, Aditya Birla Group, DFCCIL, RITES, IBM, Nokia, Adani Group, Mahindra Logistics, and Hitachi. Internships are compulsory each year, starting with opportunities at Indian Railways in the second year and extending to PSUs and private firms thereafter. Notably, CRIS, Indian Railways, DFCCIL, RITES, and CONCOR have hosted AI interns.
content.Infrastructure: Campus is a sprawling 55-acre woody area inside NAIR, featuring air-conditioned classrooms, Wi-Fi, well-furnished hostels, and shared messing facilities. For hostel accommodation, 2nd-year students typically live in rented off-campus hostels, with an on-campus hostel expected by 2026. Regarding facilities, there's a good library and reliable Wi-Fi. Sports infrastructure is limited due to shared NAIR grounds, but extracurricular clubs (tech, cultural, sports) are functional.

reviews.review_heading: Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya.
reviews.review_text: Hostel Facilities: HOSTELS ARE SO GOOD ONE CAN'T FIND IN ANY COLLEGE. AC ROOMS ARE PROVIDED. 2-SEATER ROOMS ARE THERE. BATHROOM IS ATTACHED. Wi-Fi FACILITY IS PROVIDED ALL OVER CAMPUS. MEAL IS VERY GOOD; THERE ARE VARIATIONS EVERY MONTH. AFFORDABILITY IS VERY NICE. FACILITIES GIVEN TO US CAN'T BE PROVIDED UNDER WHAT WE PAY. WE DON'T EVEN PAY 40%.

reviews.review_heading: Going in the top 10 within 5 years.
reviews.review_text: Academic building is very good and more beautiful than IITs. The mess food is good. All hostel rooms are equipped with air-conditioning and attached bathrooms. They are very neat, clean, and very beautiful. Hostels are so good, such hostels are not available in any college in India.

reviews.review_heading: In this college, faculty members are good like the school type. They are good in manner.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good like sports, clubs, and air-conditioned rooms. Hostels and free medical facilities are available. Camps are well-designed and zero-ragging. The campus is beautiful. In rooms, ethernet and full Wi-Fi are provided to students. Attached bathrooms are available in every room. On alternate days, rooms are cleaned by staff. The quality of food in the mess is very good. It offers 4-times food to students. Food includes both northern, southern, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Finally I again tell that the College is very good.
reviews.review_text:
I liked the college campus it's really very nice and beautiful. College faculty members were nice, all are from respected IITs and IIMs completed their studies. They are focused on learning and developing the skills of the students.
Hostel Facilities: I think my hostel facilities are really so nice I don't think in all over India any other colleges provide that type of hostel facilities even the IITs do not provide that type of good facilities. They are providing AC rooms with fully furnished cl...

reviews.review_heading: This is a unique college in India.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is well-designed. It has a highly integrated library, high-tech and digital classrooms, along with equipped Physics and Chemistry labs and a computer lab. The hostels are very good and provide a bed and an almirah with the room with the AC, and in each, two students are kept. The food quality is good and hygienic. No canteen facilities or medical facilities are available. Sports condition is not so good.

reviews.review_heading: National Rail and Transportation Institute, Ministry of Railways - A Hidden Gem.
reviews.review_text: There are air conditioners, geysers, washing machines, and personal bathrooms for every student in our college. Every room has Wi-Fi, which provides us high-speed internet. Our classrooms and libraries are equipped with air conditioners and Wi-Fi to ensure comfort and connectivity. We have a world-class mess facility serving us four delicious meals a day with varying cuisines. There are badminton courts, basketball and volleyball courts, a football field, and a cricket field on our campus.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best transportation college which will give competition to NITs in upcoming years.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at NRTI is really beautiful. There are different kinds of beautiful places on campus, from the greenery to the historic buildings. The hostels provide the best facilities, even compared to many famous colleges.

reviews.review_heading: A good university possesses significant potential for further development.
reviews.review_text: The institute is under construction so first-year boys right now get a hostel outside campus. But girls get hostels inside university premises. As this is a government college, you get freedom in your college life. You can roam around the college until 11 pm .

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good. The course is the best.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. The sports ground is huge. We have a volleyball court and a basketball court. All classrooms have digital smart boards and Wi-Fi.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good Infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. Classrooms are air-conditioned. Auditorium is available. There is a decent library in this college. Free Wi-Fi is available. Hostels are very good. Double-bedded and triple-bedded air-conditioned rooms are available in the hostel. You can also play sports table tennis in the hostel. Television room is available. The food served in the mess is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Here I will recommend this college to you guys if you have the interest to do something different.
reviews.review_text: If here we talk about infrastructure it is not to God here but I can say that it is not also too bad here. NRTI (now GSV) have all types of the laboratory on campus. But they don't have enough space for activities all are acquired NAIR. But I can assure you that this institute has very good greenery across the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review of National Rail and Transportation Institute.
reviews.review_text: This institute does not have a fixed campus. As a result, students are given access to accommodation options on campus that are shared with NAIR and HSRTI. Hostels are good. A new laboratory is also available. NAIR and NRTI both have access to the same library. Wi-Fi is available on our campus but occasionally it goes down because they shared with Indian Railway officers. There are some restrictions on the use of sports facilities. The food served in a mess is better.

faqs.question: Does MDU CPAS accept CLAT score?
faqs.answer: To get admission in LLB in Maharshi Dayanand University Centre for Professional and allied studies (MDU CPAS) in Gurugram, one must have scored atleast equal to or more than 45 % aggregate marks in class 12th and for differently abled people it should be equal to or more than 42.5% aggregate marks in class 12th from any renowned board. CLAT  score is not included in any criteria to get admission in LLB in this University. So, MDU CPAS does not Accept CLAT score overall, for admission in course of LLB because admission to LLB in this university is directly based upon the marks scored by the student in his or her 12th class. In case of more and more applications the priority should be given to the person who have scored more in class 12th than the student with low score in class 12th.

faqs.question: What is the seat intake for LL.M. at MDU CPAS?
faqs.answer: At Maharshi Dayanand University Centre for Professional and Allied Studies (MDU CPAS) the seat intake for LL.M  is based on the two shifts eg. shift 1 and shift 2. 30 seats for the students in LL.M  course are available or offered in shift 1 in this university and 30 seats for students are available in shift 2 for LLM course in this university in Gurugram. So we can say that overall 60 seats are available for LL.M course in this University (MDU CPAS). If we talk about the criterion for getting admission in this course LL.M then you can get direct admission to this course by just filling out the application form and on getting selected in the merit list. But also students have to qualify the one given criterion by the university which is student must have scored 50% marks in his or her class 12th and 50% marks in his or her undergraduate course LL.B. Also you got admission in this course in two shifts i.e. shift 1 and shift 2, both having 30- 30 seats available for LLM in Maharshi Dayan

faqs.question: When are MDU CPAS application forms out?
faqs.answer: Yes application forms for Maharshi Dayanand University Centre for Professional and Allied Studies (MDU CPAS) has been out for the various courses for example LLB, LLM, BBA, BCA, MBA etc. Students can get admission in various courses offered by this university by filling up this application form and further on getting selected in the merit list for the course. Merit list will be according to different criterion which are set by the university to get admission in the specific course for example for LLB Students must have scored minimum 45% of marks in their 12th class, for BBA students must have gotten 50% marks in their 12th class, for BCA students must have 50% marks in their class 12th, For postgraduation courses like LLM and MBA students must have scored 50% in class 12th and 50% in LLB and BBA respectively to be eligible to fill application form and take the admission in Maharshi Dayanand University Centre for Professional and Allied Studies in Gurugram.

faqs.question: Can I join MDU CPAS directly?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely you can join MDU CPAS ( Maharshi Dayanand University Centre for Professional and Allied Studies) directly because in almost all the courses there is no any entrance exam is being taken by the university. Also this university does not accept the scores of other entrance exams for example CLAT, CAT etc. But to get direct admission there are several criterion of minimum marks scored which include aggregate marks scored in class 12th for undergraduate courses and aggregate marks scored in graduation and class 12th for postgraduation courses. For example to get admission in LLB, one must have scored minimum 45% aggregate marks in class 12th, to get admission in BBA one must have scored 50% in class 12th, to get admission in LLM one must have scored 50% marks in  graduation and 50% marks in class 12th also, to get admission in MBA one must have scored 50% marks in class 12th and 50% marks in graduation also.

admission_overview.description: NCAAS Coimbatore admissions 2025 are both merit and entrance-based. Nehru College of Aeronautics and Applied Sciences (NCAAS) offers UG and PG courses to the aspirants of the Aviation industry. The specialisations available are Aeronautical Science, Aircraft Maintenance Engineering (AME), and Airline & Airport Management. Candidates can apply online on the official website of the institute. Apart from this, the institute also offers Value Added Courses which are a Training Programme for Online Reservation & Ticketing and, a Diploma in Travel & Tourism Foundation. With the primary objective of providing higher education in the field of Aeronautical Sciences and subsequently in other branches of Engineering and Management, Nehru Group of Institutions (NGI) established the National College of Aeronautics & Applied Sciences (NCAAS) in 1968. The institute is based in Coimbatore and offers five courses that are approved by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA). NCAAS Coimbatore is a collaborative institution of Alagappa University, Karaikudi and Lincoln University College, Malaysia.

reviews.review_heading: They have potential, but they need to improve exponentially.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are quite poor. Labs are outdated. Wi-Fi works barely. Classrooms lack proper equipment. Hostel rooms are not maintained. Mess food is below average. Canteen options are limited. Medical support is slow. Sports facilities are minimum.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is good but placement is above average.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of this college was 4 out of 5. There were proper labs, computers but number of computers was less than the actual students so sometimes it makes problems for students mostly in practical exams. reviews.review_heading: I have an average experience in college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is really average. There are labs available for all classes, but the quality is very low as computers are average, and some are working, while others are not. reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the good placements in 2025. Events organsied are good.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with teachers and placements as per my experience.

reviews.review_heading: It provided good placements in 2025. Campus life is fun.

reviews.review_heading: It gives better placement than other decent colleges.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about this college.

The mess food was also not good, but it could be adjusted because there were many other canteens and places to eat. The hostel also provided students with a mess as part of the same fee schedule.

reviews.review_heading: It is an average college with decent infrastructure, faculty, and limited placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are good. All classrooms and labs have proper instruments, with digital boards and blackboards. Labs have proper computers and chairs. Classrooms are normal, not like those in the IITs and NITs, It's like normal schools.

reviews.review_heading: The college offers good college life and learning.
reviews.review_text: All facilities necessary according to the SPPU syllabus are present. The hostel food is average. The medical facility is top-notch. Students can play sports as the college has a huge ground. Many fests have sports activities and fun games involved. Wi-Fi is also available on the campus.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Management (MBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of placements and no fests and events.

content.Placements: They try to get every deserving candidate placed. But only few types of job fields they have like sales and marketing and some time or very rarely HR. There are no fixed recruiting firms. They just give placements to students with help of their alumni network.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good and looks very aesthetic from outside. They are working continuously on building and making it large. Library is decent and gym is not good even equipments are in bad condition. Wi-Fi also works very slowly its speed is less than 1 Mbps and sometimes not close to it. Hostel looks aesthetic from outside but from inside, it is just bad and rooms are very small. When it comes to food, it is average quality not so tasty they don't have a lot on their menu list.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: BBA program with vibrant campus life but need more real-world experience.

content.Placements: We have 40 students in our batch 2023-26, with a placement rate of 20%. The highest package went up to 4 LPA, while the average was 3 LPA. India Mart, Redcliff's Labs, and pharmaceutical companies were the top recruiters, which reflects their poor industry relations. I managed to gather an internship rate of 5% where I and a few friends interned at Marketto Services.
content.Infrastructure: Campus Wi-Fi is pretty inconsistent. And computer labs lack the most updated software for effective learning. Classrooms are good but need proper maintenance. The library needs more digital resources and books, which are self-help. Also, even hostel accommodation is very basic, food is very irregular in quality, and medical support is not so good; they need more improvement to give us a better experience.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: It is a decent college if you do not have any good option in Meerut.

content.Placements: There were around 20-25 students in our batch. Placements were average in this course. The highest salary package offered was 3.5 LPA. The top role offered was analyst.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure was amazing. Our college had fabulous infrastructure. There were well-equipped labs and classrooms with Wi-Fi connectivity. The library had all the materials. The hostel had all the required amenities. Everything was available to the students.
content.Faculty: Teachers were helpful. They always clarify our doubts. The course curriculum was updated. Classes were conducted regularly.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Management (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Placements are good, and so you need not worry about it.

content.Placements: Our college is known for its placements. Placement percentage is 100%, and every single student is placed.
content.Infrastructure: This is one of the best colleges for management. Hostel facilities are too good, and the students are good too.
content.Faculty: Staffs and teachers are so intelligent. The teachers are experienced, and a few teachers have experience of more than 40 years. They help us a lot.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: The course curriculum and placements are very good.

content.Placements: The placements at MSM are above average. The highest package offered is 12 LPA, and the average package is 6.19 LPA. Many companies visit Master School Of Management for placements every year. The biggest recruiters are Google, Amazon, IBM, Honda, HDFC, Asian Paints, Aditya Birla and many more.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our course in MSM is awesome. Classrooms and labs are very good. Separate hostels are available for boys and girls at low fees. Hygiene is well-maintained. The campus hostel is too good for the students to enjoy, with all the facilities available 24x7.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Overall, college is good in terms of fees.

content.Placements: 3 batches are running the unique, super60, and non super60 from unique. Your placement is fixed, depending on your skills, but the average package is 5 to 6 LPA. It is under contract with the company. If you do not have skills, you will be fired after 1 year.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has good infrastructure with playgrounds and a lot of activities, a canteen is available at affordable price, but for medical we have to go out of the college campus. A hospital is present beside the college, Gian Sagar Medical College. Overall, SVIET Punjab offers good infrastructure and supportive facilities for students. While some areas like mess food, can improve. The campus environment, labs, library, and academic support make it a suitable place for learning and growth. Each department has its own dedicated laboratories, and the CSE/IT labs are equipped with updated systems, necessary software, and proper technical support. Classrooms are spacious, well-ventilated, and many are fitted with SMART boards to make teaching more interactive. The library is one of the strong points of the campus, offering a wide collection of textbooks, reference material, journals, and a peaceful space for self-study.

reviews.review_heading: Value for money, college and placement.
reviews.review_text: Our LDRP college has many classrooms, a well-placed library with a huge space and many sources. College has its own Wi-Fi in all the college campus, which is not excellent but also not bad. And each and every subject has its own labs for practical and machine learning. In our college hostel, there are also a huge number of decent quality rooms, and the food is good and healthy. They also have medical facilities for the faculty and students.

reviews.review_heading: If the rank is <4000, don't take admission.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not good. There is no infrastructure, it’s a very small college, and there are no good classrooms. There is no proper place to sit and enjoy college life with friends, no proper canteen, and no proper parking place. Infrastructure needs improvement and development.

reviews.review_heading: Not the best college; it's a boring college with no other activities, etc.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is about 18 years old; we cannot enjoy the campus or classrooms. Still, the college has branches like schools; they do not even have whiteboards, and they teach us on the blackboard with chalk. The labs are good, and the hostels are new and good.

reviews.review_heading: I recommend joining LDRP-ITR to become successful engineers.
reviews.review_text: In my college and hostel, there are various facilities like whole campus and hostel has it's own Wi-Fi. There are labs for different departments. It has a big library and classroom. In my college, there are total 5 hostel buildings of which 3 are non-AC and 2 are AC.

reviews.review_heading: In 2015, the LRDP market was very high. Placements were very high like 80% to 90% in 2015.
reviews.review_text: At LDRP College, there is a hostel. They both have Wi-Fi. Classrooms and the library are pure clean and peaceful. In our lab, AC is too cool but there is no AC in class. The LDRP hostel food quality is very poor because of roti maker machines, sabji, and masala. They are not tasty. In the hostel, dal and rice are awesome. Rooms are also good.

reviews.review_heading: The architecture of our college is good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are average. There is no AC in classrooms but there is AC in the labs and library. You can also use Wi-Fi for free on campus but the internet speed is not that good. Hostels are budget-friendly, and the food in the mess is average.

reviews.review_heading: Good/Average college but can improve in some things, maybe equipment and all.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was kind of good and available other than 12 AM to 6 AM in the hostel. The place was kind of clean but okayish in some places. The quality of food was okay, sometimes bad, not good. It depends upon which day what it is like; sometimes it's very good, and sometimes the whole mess is empty.

reviews.review_heading: Some faculty are not good for students, and the 2023 placements are not as good.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good. There is free Wi-Fi, good labs with i5 computers, a library, and average classrooms. Hostel room facilities are good, but the hostel mess food is of very low quality. Medical facilities are available at a minor level, and there is no sports area for the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied After Taking Admission and There Are Many False Claims in Placements.
reviews.review_text: Our classrooms do not have that great facilities. We do not have in-campus Wi-Fi. Yes, we do have labs, but they are rated 5 out of 10. We also have a library, but there is not enough resource we can have. So overall experience is below decent, and infrastructure just looks good from inside; it is not that good.

reviews.review_heading: I selected this course because I have had so much interest since I was a teenager in programming.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like Wi-Fi, a library, a reading area, and a gym are provided to the students. The infrastructure of the hostel and college is well-maintained by the trustees and is kept up-to-date. Rooms are provided with four beds and a fan. The food is normal, like what you eat at home daily. Games and other entertainment options are available.

reviews.review_heading: LDRP is a good college for engineering because of faculty and good placements in 2023. Really good.
reviews.review_text:
Network facility is too good, but there is no AC in classrooms, although there is in lab sessions.
LDRP is constructed in 4 floors and + 1 another 4-floor building.
There are many classrooms, around 90 to 100, including lab sessions.
There is 1 library with many books.
I don't know about the hostel because I am not living there.

reviews.review_heading: For The Future Student The Best College known.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like wifi, library, reading area and gym is provided to the students. And the infrastructure of the hostel and college is moderate by the trustees, and manage well up to date. The room is provided in which 4 bed and 1 fan is available. The food is normal like you are eating in home in daily basis. Games and much more are entertainment zone are there.

reviews.review_heading: Review about LDRP College.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good, easily reachable, and the staff is friendly. The infrastructure is decent; there are well-equipped labs and a library. In the labs, computers are working properly, and the library has all the necessary books as well as many reference books. The hostel is also decent, with good food, and the rooms are spacious. However, there is no ground on the college campus.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is now developing as ground level auditorium and admission office are renovated
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is not well established like classrooms are not fitted with Ac's projectors problem is also there as portable projectors are used so sometimes. Projectors are not available and  faculties have to take classes without it. Wifi is not available but in lab with ethernet cable you can access internet and labs are well Ac fitted.

reviews.review_heading: My review for college and hostel.
reviews.review_text:
They provide 10 gbps WIFI for students and also faculty, and they install air conditioning systems in each lab but not in the classroom, and they also provide a big library.
There is not any big medical center in college, but a first aid kit is available on every floor.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Design - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It has a well-structured campus and a good campus life.

content.Placements: 90% of students get placed in the college. The highest package is 9 LPA and the lowest package is 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are TCS, Infosys, Wipro, etc. The average package is 4.5 LPA. It selects a majority of students from our college.
content.Infrastructure: It has a good infrastructure with all facilities. FISAT offers modern infrastructure with smart classrooms, well-equipped labs, and Wi-Fi connections. It also has a central library. Hostels are good, safe, clean, and 24x7 security concerns for both boys and girls.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Design - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The real story of FISAT - Learning, campus life, and opportunities.

content.Placements: I am studying B.Tech in computer science and design at FISAT College in Angamaly. The college is good, but sometimes classes feel long and boring. Placements are decent, with many students getting jobs in big companies like TCS and Wipro. The highest package offered is 6 LPA. The lowest salary is 3 LPA, and the average salary is around 4 LPA - 5 LPA. A good number of students got internships in top companies. Overall, I am happy with my experience here, but there's always room for improvement, especially on campus facilities.
content.Infrastructure: The college has good Wi-Fi. Our labs are okay with all the computers. But sometimes they do not work well. Classrooms are big, but some need more fans. The library is nice with many books, but it's a little small. Hostels are fine, but sometimes the rooms are hot. The food in the mess is okay, not great. The canteen has snacks, which are nice. The medical facilities are good with a small clinic. For sports, we have a playground, but it's not used much. Overall, it's okay, but could be better.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it has a good campus with every element students need.

content.Placements: In our department, placement is an attractive part, and 90% of our students get placed at good companies. Many good and reputed companies visit here for placements. This college provides us with many more placement opportunities. They even prepare us for placement interviews. Our seniors got placed at good companies.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are overall good. The food provided is also nice apart from some food that can be changed otherwise it might be good. Our rooms are also well-maintained. Cleaning staff members are also too good and maintain the hostel nicely.

faqs.question: Are admissions at Federal Institute of Science and Technology entrance-based or merit-based?
faqs.answer: Yes, entrance-based admissions are the main criteria for B.Tech programs, as passing JEE Main or comparable national/state exams is required. Merit and admissions chances are determined by rank on these tests.Prior to being admitted, students must take and pass national engineering admission exams such as JEE Main. The institute determines the qualifying cut-off scores. Therefore, passing the eligibility test for admission is crucial.After that, admissions are determined by the entrance exam results' All India ranking. Only the students' JEE Main merit rankings are used to fill seats.In addition to admission ranking, the 12th standard percentage may also be taken into consideration for seats under reserved quota or at the institute level. However, the determining factor for the majority of seats is entrance exam merit.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with my college. There are good placements every year.
reviews.review_text: We were provided with a very good classroom which contains a visualizing projector which the teachers can present any notes easily. It contains digital boards which can be used as monitors also we can write on them using specialized pens. it also contains a large number of desks and benches. Classrooms were very clean. Hostels also were clean and tidy. In each room, 3 students can stay. Rooms were provided with greater facilities. Hostel food was very tasty, clean, and pure.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty and not satisfied with campus life; placement is okay.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is not that good. Poor Wi-Fi speed, and the bathroom is okay, but they clean it three times a week and clean the floor every day. The timing for boys is 8:00 PM, and then the gate will be closed; for girls, it’s 6:30 PM. So, we can't explore the outside world that much. The pricing for the room and food is good compared to other hostels, and the food is good here.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college, good tutors, and good atmosphere.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi for students is available at the campus as well as at the hostel. The college has brilliant infrastructure and the library is very good. Sports such as cricket, football, volleyball, and basketball are also promoted.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members and all facilities are nice. I am just satisfied.

reviews.review_heading: FISAT college.
reviews.review_text: The college is built on a large plot of land with a huge main campus building surrounded by greenery and a well-maintained garden. Walkways and corridors relax our mind and soul. reviews.review_heading: Strong faculty and curriculum, good placement and industry-ready focus at FISAT.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best Private Eng. Colleges in Kerala

reviews.review_heading: FISAT is your dream college.

reviews.review_heading: There are so many facilities if you are willing to explore

individual_reviews.title: The best college for a technical course.

content.Placements: In my course, mostly 70% of students get placement. The highest package offered is 21 LPA, and the average package is 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Zomato, Microsoft, Wipro, and LinkedIn. Top roles offered by the companies are telecalling, web development, data analysis, and purchase assistance.
content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is so good, there are clean classes, well-hygiene washrooms, and an RO water service facility. The top role offered in my course is web development.

The hostel is also the best according to infrastructure, and the mess food, I would say, is okayish. Hostels have good Wi-Fi and hot and cold showers, and a sports ground.

reviews.review_heading: The best college for a technical course.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is so good, there are clean classes, well-hygiene washrooms, and an RO water service facility. There is Wi-Fi available in all classes, and the seminar halls are wide and have enough space for 200 students to be seated at once. Also, there are clean corridors.

reviews.review_heading: Good in infrastructure, syllabus, and they conduct excellent training every semester.
reviews.review_text: Well, I will say that in terms of infrastructure, this is the best. It's so goated that multiple movies, web series, and ads are being shot here. Classrooms are well-equipped with centralized AC, smart boards, speakers, and Wi-Fi. The library is also well-spaced and has a lot of books and quite a space to study. The hostel is also the best according to infrastructure, and the mess food, I would say, is okayish. Hostels have good Wi-Fi and hot and cold showers, and a sports ground.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college with good and experienced faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure with greenery. The size of the campus is very large. Hostels are also available that are separate for both boys and girls. Wi-Fi connectivity is also available, but it is only in the academic block and is weaker in hostels. The overall ecosystem promotes focused learning.

reviews.review_heading: The perfect hub of technology .
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is overall good for Students. Our department has well-equipped labs, working project tools, smart classrooms, Wi-Fi access, and a decent library with enough books for reference. The hostel facilities are also satisfactory with clean rooms, drinking water, and proper security.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best budget-friendly colleges, with job opportunities, and a great environment.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is genuinely one of the best things about Echelon. For our CSE department, the computer labs are modern, fully air-conditioned, and equipped with the latest software and high-speed internet. The Wi-Fi coverage across the academic blocks and the library is reliable. Classrooms are all smart with projectors, which makes learning interactive. The central library is huge and has a massive collection of books and digital resources.

Mess provides good quality food to us, and it's healthy for us. The medical and sports facilities are also available.

review_summary.college_name: Suresh Gyan Vihar University Jaipur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotherapy - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: This college is a very good option for those whose budget is low and who belong to Bihar.

content.Placements: 80 to 90 percent of students were placed this year. The placement range of each department is very good, and almost all of them are placed. The pharmacy departments placement range is better than other departments, and the placement range of HMCT is also good.
content.Infrastructure: Good infrastructure is available for each departments students, and facilities such as Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms and a library are also available. Single bedrooms, double bedrooms and 5 seater bedrooms are also available. Good quality food is available in both the mess and the canteen.

individual_reviews.course: BCA Google Cloud Program (GCP) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely good because of the faculty, good environment, and infrastructure.

content.Placements: I am a student of Suresh Gyan Vihar University pursuing BCA with Google Cloud. Many companies offer to those students who have the highest score ranking. SGVU is a private university located in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. It was established in 2008, under the Suresh Gyan Vihar University, Jaipur, ACT 2008, ACT No. 16 of 2008. The parent institution dates back further originally, the system started under a body called Sahitya Sadawart Samiti (set up in 1938), and before becoming a university, had legacy schools & colleges. SGVU is recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and has approval from the organization.

individual_reviews.course: M.Pharma in Pharmaceutics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: One thing I love about is the peaceful environment over here.

content.Placements: I great place where you can be hire by the top recruiters. Many seniors are there who have been selected because of their dedication towards the field. Package depends on the interview sessions on an average it is 4lpa. Internship opportunities come from government labs.
content.Infrastructure: We have excellent library, full network Wi-Fi, interactive classrooms, well-equipped labs. In hostel it will like home. Well cooked food, safe drinking water, access to gym, ground for various sports. There is also activity area helps to focus on your hobbies.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Marketing - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Well-maintained campus with decent placements needs better faculty.

content.Placements: I completed my MBA from the 2022-2024 batch. Around 85% of students from our course were successfully placed. The highest package offered was 12 LPA, the lowest was 3.5 LPA and the average package stood at 6.8 LPA. Top recruiting companies included TCS, Infosys, Deloitte, Wipro, and Accenture. Nearly 70% of students secured internships in firms like EY, HDFC Bank, ICICI, and Capgemini. The most offered roles were business analyst, marketing executive, financial analyst, operations associate, and hr executive.
content.Infrastructure: Our department was well-equipped with modern classrooms, Wi-Fi, computer labs, and a dedicated library section for academic support. Hostel facilities were decent with clean rooms, 24/7 water and electricity, and good security. The mess served hygienic food with a fair variety, while the canteen offered snacks and beverages. Basic medical support was available on campus. Sports facilities included grounds for cricket, volleyball, and indoor games.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Commerce (M.Com) in Accountancy - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college in Jaipur.

content.Placements: I remember when I was pursuing an M.Com from this university, almost 60% of students got placements with the highest package of 6 LPA. Many students got internship opportunities from multinational companies. I pursued M.Com online from this university.
content.Infrastructure: I visited the university campus once. The infrastructure of the university is large, good, and vibrant. The SGVU library contains a number of books, and I hear it is the largest library among universities. The whole campus is covered with greenery. The SGVU campus is too good for pursuing our degree.

faqs.question: Does Suresh Gyan Vihar University - SGVU conduct GD/PI as part of its admission process?
faqs.answer: Yes, Suresh Gyan Vihar University (SGVU) conducts group discussions and personal interviews as part of its admission process. reviews.review_heading: This college is a very good option for those whose budget is low and who belong to Bihar.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure is available for each departments students, and facilities such as Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms and a library are also available. Single bedrooms, double bedrooms and 5 seater bedrooms are also available. Good quality food is available in both the mess and the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good because of the faculty, good environment, and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities available in the college, like good classrooms and a library system, are good. If you need any help or want to borrow a book, you can. All is going well. reviews.review_text: We have excellent library, full network Wi-Fi, interactive classrooms, well-equipped labs. In hostel it will like home. Well cooked food, safe drinking water, access to gym, ground for various sports. There is also activity area helps to focus on your hobbies.

Hostel facilities were decent with clean rooms,  24/7 water and electricity, and good security. The mess served hygienic food with a fair variety, while the canteen offered snacks and beverages. Basic medical support was available on campus. Sports facilities included grounds for cricket, volleyball, and indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in Jaipur.
reviews.review_text: I visited the university campus once. The infrastructure of the university is large, good, and vibrant. The SGVU library contains a number of books, and I hear it is the largest library among universities. The whole campus is covered with greenery. The SGVU campus is too good for pursuing our degree.

reviews.review_heading: Choose your college- Suresh Gyan Vihar University, Jaipur.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very good, and a friendly environment is available in the college. College provides all facilities like Wi-Fi connection, library, and sports complex. The quality of food is very tasty and good and different types of food are available. All facilities are provided in mess and medical facilities are available in college and hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements in the industry.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are available in my college. Hostel have boards and mess provide healthy food. Wi-Fi is available in hostels and classrooms are very comfortable. Library is available. They provide fruits and vegetables in the morning.

reviews.review_heading: Great college and wonderful college life towards studies.
reviews.review_text: All kinds of facilities are available here based on what is important to a student for education and their development. Library with all the latest books, computer labs with fast working computer system are available. There is a good environment for hostel students to live in and various stadium for sports based on the different volleyball, basketball, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely a world of growing opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are outstanding in my course and department. The whole university consists of Wi-Fi, labs, high connectivity network, AC classrooms, and well-maintained systems. Library is very vast and consists of thousands of books. Facilities like elevator and accelerator are available. Hostels are maintained to a very great extent in terms of cleanliness and greenery. The hygienic food is served in the mess and canteen. Medical facilities are top tier and on the other hand,...

reviews.review_heading: Amazing facilities with lush green campus.

Additionally, sports and other curriculum activities are also encouraged, playgrounds are there separately for games such as cricket, basketball, badminton, and much more.

admission_process.title: Indira Gandhi National Tribal University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Indira Gandhi National Tribal University admissionis completely entrance-based. The university offers BSc, BPharma, MA, BA, MCA and other courses at UG and PG, doctoral and certificate levels in the fields of Science, Arts, Pharmacy and others. Admission to the UG courses is based on a valid score in the CUET-UG exam, followed by a counselling round. Additionally, for admission to PG courses,Indira Gandhi National Tribal Universityaccepts CUET-PG scores. Further, for some UG, diploma and certificate courses university offers admission based on last-qualifying exam scores. Read to know more about Indira Gandhi National Tribal University admission along with course-wise eligibility, selection, fees, seat intake and admission process 2025:

Indira Gandhi National Tribal University courseadmissions are entrance-based for all courses. However, for some UG, certificate and diploma courses, admission is merit-based. Students are required to go through the national-level entrances and then appear for the institute-level selection rounds for final admission. Check below the eligibility and selection criteria for a few of the topIndira Gandhi National Tribal University courses:

Indira Gandhi National Tribal University feeis a sum of various components such as tuition fee, caution deposit, exam fee, etc. Some of the fee components like caution deposit are one-time paid while tuition fee is paid annually.

Coming to affordability is one of the strong reasons why many don't opt for a degree or a college. The availability of education loans and scholarships has made education accessible. However, the terms and conditions required to become eligible for a student loan or a scholarship often stand as a challenge. Once the seat is allotted, candidates are required to pay the course fee to confirm their admission. Below is the intake for the top Indira Gandhi National Tribal University courses:

Indira Gandhi National Tribal University accepts admission through national-level entrance exams, such as CUET, and CUET-PG, Candidates who meet the eligibility and selection criteria established by the university can apply by filling out the application form through the Indira Gandhi National Tribal University official website. Given below is the Indira Gandhi National Tribal University admission process 2025:
Step 1: Application Process 2025

For admission to any of the programmes at the Indira Gandhi National Tribal University, candidates are required to fill out the application form through the university’s official website by paying the required application fee for final submission.
Step 2: Selection Criteria 2025

Indira Gandhi National Tribal University admission is completely entrance exam-based. The university inducts candidates through various national-level entrance exams, such as CUET-UG and CUET-PG, for different programmes. Candidates having valid scores in the aforementioned exams will be shortlisted for the counselling process.
Step 3: Final Seat Allotment 2025

After the completion of the counselling process, candidates will be required to complete the final admission process, i.e. document verification and Indira Gandhi National Tribal University fee payment for final seat allotment.

placement_data.title: Indira Gandhi National Tribal University Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: nbsp;As per the NIRF report 2024 released by Indira Gandhi National Tribal University, the median package offered during UG 3-year and UG 4-year placements 2023 stood at INR 2.6 LPA and INR 2.4 LPA , respectively. Further, the median package offered during PG 2-year placements 2023 stood at I NR 3 LPA .

Earlier, as per the NIRF report 2023, 36 MBA, 14 BPharma and 4 MPharma students were placed during IGNTU placements 2022. The median package offered to MBA students stood at INR 86,000 LPA. For BPharma and MPharma students, the median package offered during IGNTU placements 2022 was INR 2 LPA and INR 4 LPA, respectively.

faqs.question: How are MBA placements at The Indira Gandhi National Tribal University?
faqs.answer: This university doesn't provide any placement services for students. Placement opportunities are only available for 1 branch. There are no placements for professional courses. Only around 20% of the students are placed. Salary packages offered were not the best, and not even internship opportunities were provided to the students. All the students search for jobs and internships on their own. A total of 21 out of 67 MBA students were placed during placements in 2021. However, 18 students were placed in 2020. The student must have passed a Graduate degree in the respective field with a minimum percentage of 50% to be admitted to the MBA.

hostel.description: There are three hostels in the Campus. Two boy’s hostels named as Govind Guru Boys hostel and Sone hostel and one girl's hostel named as Rani Durgawati Girls hostel. The students are provided with basic amenities like a cot, table, chair, cupboard in their rooms. Hostel’s common rooms have LED TV. There is adequate water supply as well as Solar geysers systems installed in the hostels towards conservation of nature and save electricity through the conventional source. There is a common computer room for the inmates. The whole campus including hostel is Wi-Fi enabled. There is a gym hall equipped with various machines in both boys and girls hostel. There is a separate open gym for girls. The hostel campus maintenance like cleaning/sweeping is outsourced. The security services are round the clock.

paragraphs: The IES University Admission 2025is open now. They collectively offer undergraduate and postgraduate programmes in the fields of Engineering, Commerce, Humanities, Management and Sciences. The university also offers PhD courses. Admission to all the UG and PG courses atIES Universityis merit-based. Students seeking admission to IES University must apply through its official website.

The university offers more than 20 full-time courses. The mode of application to apply for any of the offered programmes is both online and offline. Below are the key highlights forIES University admissions:

IES University coursesoffer UG, PG, and various other courses to students. IES University admission process includes registration, selection and fee payment. Below are the steps to get a seat in IES University:
